**Finding submitted: deviation (WARRANTY).**

- **What the document has:** Section 9 "Warranties" (p0055–p0058) contains only mutual corporate-existence/authority/enforceability warranties plus a Globix acknowledgement. Sections 1, 2, 5 and 10 contain scope, launch-date, acceptance and boilerplate terms — no performance or conformance warranty, no remedy, and (helpfully) no "AS IS" disclaimer. Searches for disclaimer, workmanlike, documentation-conformance, malicious code and error-correction language returned nothing.
- **Why it fails fallback:** every fallback element (90-day software conformance, 30-day services warranty, repair/replace, refund) is absent.
- **Cure:** one insert of a new Section 9(c) carrying exactly the four fallback elements, leaving all existing text untouched. Preferred-only elements (12-month software period, workmanlike standard, legal compliance, no malicious code) were deliberately not volunteered.
